answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 32 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in lantern, queued in prism, and whisper publishes the wait time. A farm of 84 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 664 identities would post 3590 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
